look_here_first: Look at the flower first: broad flat pale-green lobes are strongly netted with dark green lines, and the center has conspicuous silvery reflective anther appendages—the 'pearl.'

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: opposite deeply cordate leaves; stems and petioles conspicuously hairy

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: rotate broad corolla lobes strongly dark-reticulate and glabrous adaxially

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: corona reduced to a very low yellow undulate ring

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: 8–15 cm fusiform follicle, sparsely to moderately muricate

key_traits.label: Milkweed vine training
key_traits.text: Use fused corolla plus corona/gynostegium and follicle armature; preserve modern genus placement even when older/source labels use Matelea.
